title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
summary: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.
body: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布AI对齐与安全领域专家Paul Christiano正式加入OpenAI基金会董事会，并同时进入其安全与安全委员会（Safety and Security Committee），此举旨在加强组织在模型对齐和技术标准制定方面的治理力量。
